resources.string: Paste the encryption key from your computer. Find it in key.json in your Freehold folder. It is the only thing that can read your backups, so it never travels over a backend.
Where should blocks be stored? Your GitHub username and a classic token with the \'repo\' scope. The token stays on this phone.
Back up automatically in the background
Files are split, deduplicated and encrypted on this phone before anything is uploaded. Backups run on any connection, including mobile data.
